tools.name: promote_waitlist_patient_to_slot
tools.description: Moves a patient's waitlist entry into the clinic's booked appointments for the given open slot, taking it off the waitlist. The slot is then marked as booked so nobody else can take it.

params.name: waitlist_entry_id
params.description: ID of the waitlist entry to promote.

params.name: slot_id
params.description: ID of the open schedule slot to book the patient into.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/clinic/scheduling.db"


@dataclass
class PromotionResult:
    appointment_id: int
    patient_id: int
    provider_id: int
    starts_at: str
    waitlist_entry_id: int
    slot_id: int


def _connect():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


@tool
def promote_waitlist_patient_to_slot(waitlist_entry_id: int, slot_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = _connect()
    try:
        with conn:
            entry = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, patient_id, reason, requested_provider_id FROM waitlist WHERE id = ?",
                (waitlist_entry_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if entry is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Waitlist entry {waitlist_entry_id} not found")
            slot = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, provider_id, starts_at, ends_at, status FROM schedule_slots WHERE id = ?",
                (slot_id,),
            ).fetchone()
            if slot is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Slot {slot_id} not found")
            if slot["status"] != "open":
                raise ValueError(f"Slot {slot_id} is not open (status: {slot['status']})")
            cur = conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO appointments (patient_id, provider_id, slot_id, starts_at, ends_at, reason, status, created_at) "
                "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'booked', ?)",
                (
                    entry["patient_id"],
                    slot["provider_id"],
                    slot_id,
                    slot["starts_at"],
                    slot["ends_at"],
                    entry["reason"],
                    datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                ),
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM waitlist WHERE id = ?", (waitlist_entry_id,))
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE schedule_slots SET status = 'booked', appointment_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (cur.lastrowid, slot_id),
            )
        result = PromotionResult(
            appointment_id=cur.lastrowid,
            patient_id=entry["patient_id"],
            provider_id=slot["provider_id"],
            starts_at=slot["starts_at"],
            waitlist_entry_id=waitlist_entry_id,
            slot_id=slot_id,
        )
        return asdict(result)
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: add_appointment_note
tools.description: Adds a staff note to an appointment and returns all notes recorded on that appointment so far.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the appointment to annotate.

params.name: note
params.description: Text of the note to add.

params.name: author
params.description: Name or staff ID of the person writing the note.

import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/clinic/scheduling.db"


@tool
def add_appointment_note(appointment_id: int, note: str, author: str) -> list:
    c = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with c:
            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO appointment_notes (appointment_id, author, body, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (appointment_id, author, note, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
            )
        rs = c.execute(
            "SELECT author, body, created_at FROM appointment_notes WHERE appointment_id = ? ORDER BY created_at",
            (appointment_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        return [{"author": a, "note": b, "created_at": t} for a, b, t in rs]
    finally:
        c.close()

tools.name: cancel_appointment_with_deposit_refund
tools.description: Cancels a patient's appointment, permanently removing it from the schedule, and refunds the booking deposit to the patient's card. Cancellations inside the late-cancel window get a partial refund based on the clinic's policy percentage.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the appointment to cancel.

params.name: cancellation_reason
params.description: Reason for the cancellation, attached to the refund record.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("clinic-billing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/clinic/scheduling.db"
LATE_CANCEL_WINDOW_HOURS = 24
LATE_CANCEL_REFUND_PERCENT = 50


def _compute_refund_amount(deposit_amount_cents: int, appointment_start_iso: str) -> int:
    appointment_start_time = datetime.fromisoformat(appointment_start_iso)
    if appointment_start_time.tzinfo is None:
        appointment_start_time = appointment_start_time.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    time_until_appointment = appointment_start_time - datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if time_until_appointment < timedelta(hours=LATE_CANCEL_WINDOW_HOURS):
        return deposit_amount_cents * LATE_CANCEL_REFUND_PERCENT // 100
    return deposit_amount_cents


@mcp.tool()
def cancel_appointment_with_deposit_refund(appointment_id: int, cancellation_reason: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        appointment_record = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, starts_at, deposit_payment_intent_id, deposit_amount_cents FROM appointments WHERE id = ?",
            (appointment_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if appointment_record is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Appointment {appointment_id} not found")

        refund_amount_cents = 0
        stripe_refund_identifier = None
        deposit_payment_intent_id = appointment_record["deposit_payment_intent_id"]
        if deposit_payment_intent_id and appointment_record["deposit_amount_cents"]:
            refund_amount_cents = _compute_refund_amount(
                appointment_record["deposit_amount_cents"], appointment_record["starts_at"]
            )
            if refund_amount_cents > 0:
                stripe_refund = stripe.Refund.create(
                    payment_intent=deposit_payment_intent_id,
                    amount=refund_amount_cents,
                    reason="requested_by_customer",
                    metadata={"appointment_id": str(appointment_id), "note": cancellation_reason[:450]},
                )
                stripe_refund_identifier = stripe_refund.id

        with database_connection:
            database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?", (appointment_id,))

        return {
            "appointment_id": appointment_id,
            "cancelled": True,
            "refund_amount_cents": refund_amount_cents,
            "refund_id": stripe_refund_identifier,
        }
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

tools.name: charge_no_show_fee_and_cancel
tools.description: Charges the patient's saved card the clinic's no-show fee for a missed appointment and then cancels that appointment.
tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("clinic-billing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"]
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/clinic/scheduling.db"


@mcp.tool()
def charge_no_show_fee_and_cancel(appointment_id: int, no_show_fee_cents: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        stripe_customer_id, saved_payment_method_id = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT p.stripe_customer_id, p.default_payment_method_id FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.id = ?",
            (appointment_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        no_show_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=no_show_fee_cents, currency="usd", customer=stripe_customer_id,
            payment_method=saved_payment_method_id, off_session=True, confirm=True,
            metadata={"appointment_id": str(appointment_id), "type": "no_show_fee"},
        )
        with database_connection:
            database_connection.execute("UPDATE appointments SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id = ?", (appointment_id,))
        return {"appointment_id": appointment_id, "payment_intent_id": no_show_payment_intent.id, "status": no_show_payment_intent.status}
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
